options.setting-help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run its policy's verbs only (the default policy: show) (no set/clear, no request poll now, no request reload, no restart, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited (`file:<path>` = the token from an owner-only file)

options.name: audit
options.setting-help: the SCR audit trail: the sink, the forwarding, the rotation, the kill switch

options.name: audit-log
options.setting-help: SCR audit trail: a file path or - for stdout (the docker/journald way); `none` = no local file (the forward carries the trail); default: the XDG state home (~/.local/state/modbus-scraper/audit.log)
options.help: SCR audit trail: a file path or - for stdout (the docker/journald way); `none` turns the local file off (with a forward spelled that is the remote-only mode); the XDG state home (~/.local/state/modbus-scraper/audit.log) when unset

options.name: audit-forward
options.help: also forward the SCR audit trail: syslog (the local socket auto-scan), syslog:/path (an explicit socket), udp://host[:514] (RFC5426, best-effort) or tcp://host[:514] (RFC6587 framing) — the off-box copy carries the per-writer hash chain, so a scheduled search at the collector can alert on a chain break; docs/AUDIT.md

options.name: no-audit-log
options.setting-help: disable the SCR audit trail
options.help: disable the SCR audit trail

options.setting-help: log every HTTP request at INFO

value-help.on: audit trail for who polled /metrics and when

options.help: log every HTTP request at INFO

options.name: log-level

value-help.DEBUG: per-poll detail + the HTTP access log at DEBUG

options.help: log level

options.name: dump-path
options.help: the state dump: the live setting overrides (the poll plan, the caps, the log surface — the tokens apart) as one JSON, written 0600 with an integrity hash (a restore refuses a tampered, unsigned or group-writable dump); dumped on the request dump command, the graceful shutdown and every --dump-interval seconds; loaded on start only with --restore-on-start, on demand with the request restore command

options.name: restore-on-start
options.help: load the state dump when the daemon starts (needs --dump-path) — the live overrides ride again instead of a cold start; without it the dump loads on demand

show.name: connections
show.setting-help: the live HTTP clients of /metrics: the gate counters, one row per peer IP

show.name: uplink
show.setting-help: the inverter link: session counters, per-block latency and errors

show.name: uplink-sources
show.setting-help: the register map: one row per polled register — fc, register, the range that fetches it, source

show.name: inputs
show.setting-help: the declared compute expression inputs (the reserved four and the spec's declared entries), each bracketed with the metric whose value it carries

show.name: inputs-metrics
show.setting-help: the exported metrics: one [section]-bracketed line per metric the exposition serves (the built-in scraper_* block included), sorted by name

show.name: metrics-acl-table
show.setting-help: the metrics ACL as its rule chain, one entry per line: allow 0.0.0.0/0 (any), deny 0.0.0.0/0 (none), the whitelist spelled out — or the ip-prefix acl file's own rules with their descs

commands.name: inspect
commands.help: one pretty dump of everything (the state, the counters, the caps)

commands.name: request
commands.help: the state machinery: the dump written and restored, the config re-read, the poll woken, the session dropped

commands.name: request-reload
commands.help: save the live overrides and restart the whole daemon (the config file and the flags are re-resolved)

commands.name: request-restart
commands.help: drop the Modbus session (reconnects on the next poll)

commands.name: set
commands.help: configure a setting (set metrics interval 5, set log-access on)

commands.name: clear
commands.help: restore a setting to its configured value (clear modbus interval, clear system log-level)
